title: Plans and predictions
grammar: Will, Going to, Present Continuous for future
function: Talk about the future with different degrees of certainty

phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn the different ways to talk about the future: will for predictions, going to for plans, Present Continuous for arrangements.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences. I think it will rain tomorrow. We are going to buy a house. I am meeting Sarah at 6. Notice: will = prediction, going to = plan, Present Continuous = fixed arrangement.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.prompt: Look at those clouds! It ___ rain.
phases.explanation: When we have evidence, we use going to.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Write 3 predictions about your future and 3 plans for next year.

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.prompt: I ___ my dentist at 4 pm tomorrow.
